_comment: sentencepiece-style bpe tokenizer.json pins (docs/algorithms/spm_bpe.md §1), in the order of the coverage census (census/coverage.json: bpe-byte-fallback groups by (b) downloads), gemma 4 first. Anonymous hub downloads only; gated originals come from public byte-identical copies where one exists. 'same_as' lists other repos whose file has the same sha256 (or, where noted, the same semantics). Fetch: uv run tests/spm/fetch.py

gemma4.why: CRITICAL TARGET. public; every gemma 4 instruct size ships this exact file: Replace(' ' -> U+2581) without Prepend, a Split(' ', MergedWithPrevious) that never cuts (doc §1.1), decoder Replace + ByteFallback + Fuse, TemplateProcessing [$A] (no bos), 24 special added tokens, none normalized

gemma4-base.why: every gemma 4 base size ships this file: identical to gemma4 except the template, [<bos> $A] (id 2)

yi-dolphin.why: census #2 by downloads: yi 1.5 vocab (64000) with Replace only, no pre-tokenizer, a decoder WITHOUT Strip, template [$A], 5 added tokens

gemma3.why: 262144 vocab, 6415 added tokens (one beyond the vocab: <image_soft_token> = 262144)

embeddinggemma.why: census #4: google/embeddinggemma-300m is gated (sha256 6852f8d5...); this public copy is in the same census configuration group: gemma 3 shape, template [<bos> $A <eos>]

tinyllama.why: llama 2 as meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf ships it today (gated; same size 1,842,767 bytes, census: byte-identical): specials normalized=false

gemma2.why: byte-identical to google/gemma-2-9b's current file (gated; the hub api reports this sha256); gemma 1 vocab, other merges, a Split that never cuts, 249 added tokens, <0x09> missing

phi3.5.why: census #9 (the phi-3 group): llama 2 text model, rstrip added tokens

phi3.why: llama 2 text model with 11 added tokens beyond the vocab, rstrip=true on all of them, template without bos

gemma1.why: google/gemma-* is gated; Replace normalizer only, no pre-tokenizer, <0x09> missing (tab is a vocab char), 217 added tokens
same_as: semantics: unsloth/gemma-7b@a0aa8221f534401bd60aa694dd8dd3022dbaf47a (sha256 f559f2189f392b4555613965f089e7c4d300b41fbe080bf79da0d676e33ee7f0: merges as pairs, same content)

llama1.why: census #15: llama 1, specials normalized=true (as the 2023 llama 2 file)

codellama.why: llama 2 + 16 infilling tokens in the model vocab (32016) and 11 more merges

mistral-v0.3.why: as v0.1 with a 32768 vocab and 771 special added tokens ([INST], [control_N], ...)

llama2.why: the July-2023 meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf file as mirrored by NousResearch: Prepend+Replace, no pre-tokenizer, specials normalized=TRUE (matched as '▁<s>'); meta's current file is the 'tinyllama' pin

mistral-small-2409.why: census #24: mistral's 32768 vocab with Replace only (no Metaspace), no Strip, 771 added (751 special)

yi.why: Sequence[Replace] normalizer without Prepend, Strip decoder, vocab ids with holes (63992 entries, max id 63999), a repeated added-token content, no post-processor

gemma3n.why: gemma 3 merges, a 262400 vocab, 6670 added tokens (264 special)
